snippet.title: ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos EPISODE YAMATO Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
[Update] Sep 24, 2021
The DLC "ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos EPISODE YAMATO" is now available for SteamVR, and PSVR!
Please enjoy the brand new story with a sword in your metal hands and a decision to make!
*The DLC isn't available in some countries for PSVR



Japan’s Biggest Award-Winning VR Game delivers a new DLC for Oculus Quest!
Store Page: https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/2977398372335251/

Website: https://altdeus.com/en/dlc/yamato/ 

ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos, the sci-fi, anime-style adventure with a twisting narrative and difficult player choices developed by the industry professionals at MyDearest Inc., launches its DLC, ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos EPISODE YAMATO, on June 10.

The main story, ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos, released on the Oculus Store for Oculus Quest and Rift devices on Dec 3 in 2020. Since then, it has won the 2020 Famitsu/Dengeki Award in the Adventure Category and become one of the top-rated paid apps on the Oculus Store.

In the new DLC, ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos EPISODE YAMATO, you play as Second Lieutenant Yamato Amanagi, a member of Prometheus and pilot of the Ares Makhia. The Swordstrike system, the awesome power of Ares Makhia's sword, provides you with new interactive experiences, taking approximately 2 hours to complete all of the story branches.

About ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos EPISODE YAMATO:

Game Modes: Single User
Supported Player Modes: Standing
Supported Platforms: Oculus Quest, Oculus Quest 2
*Available on other platforms at a later date TBA
Genres: Action, Adventure, Narrative
Dubbings: English (US), Japanese
Subtitles: English (US), Chinese (China), French (France), Japanese
Release Date: June 10, 2021
Price: $9.99
Developer: MyDearest Inc.
Publisher: MyDearest Inc.
Website: https://altdeus.com/en/dlc/yamato/ 

About MyDearest Inc.:
MyDearest Inc. is one of the leading VR game developers in Japan with a passion for unconventional storytelling. Their desire to share intricate narratives and gripping VR experiences have taken their journey to the West with the release of their mystery adventure game TOKYO CHRONOS in 2019. After running a successful Kickstarter campaign for TOKYO CHRONOS and accepting accolades from Oculus, MyDearest Inc. sets its sights on global releases again with titles like ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos.


------
New title from multi-award-winning VR studio!
DYSCHRONIA: Chronos Alternate
https://dyschroniaca.com/en/
